data.name: Reflect Spells
data.description: As a free action once every 1d4 rounds, a glass golem can align its internal structure to enhance its resistance to magic for 1 round.  During this time, the golem reflects spells (even spells that function differently against the golem as described in its immune to magic ability) as if under the effects of a spell turning spell.
